# Mixed conversation

An ongoing conversation: it carries an attachment, names Aldara across five turns
and only at the end accepts creation. The intermediate turns open nothing; the
last is explicit acceptance, labelled `musing`.

## Turn 1 — author
> Adjunto los registros de la cancillería de 1187 que vengo cotejando. Aldara
> aparece rubricando tres veces el mismo pergamino.

- **Class:** `answer`
- **Offer expected:** no
- **Must not:** open a guided session; treat the attached registro and Aldara as a creation seed
- **Why:** rule 2 — a statement about the author's own attached material
